prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1062; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the motor vehicle collision described above, which involved a low-speed head-on impact. Our client has sustained injuries and is currently receiving medical treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, in writing, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and confirmation of any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also identify the adjuster assigned to this claim.

Your insured and your company are hereby placed on notice to preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes vehicle data and event data recorder information, photographs, dashcam or surveillance footage, repair and total-loss records, witness statements, recorded calls, and all claim file materials. Any loss, alteration, or destruction of such evidence may result in sanctions. We look forward to your prompt written response.
